permissions.name: audio.playback
permissions.reason: YouTube and NAS video: plays the video's sound on the phone while the stills play on the glasses.

permissions.name: device.messaging
permissions.reason: Sends test pictures to the glasses as fast as the link allows and reads back how many they drew.

permissions.name: files.user-selected
permissions.reason: Lets the optional Clip content read a .mmv file you pick (a video preconverted on the PC into grey test frames).

permissions.name: network
permissions.reason: Asks the MM Video engine on this phone (Termux) for the video stills and the sound track.

permissions.name: storage
permissions.reason: Keeps the results table (one row per run) on the phone so you can compare sizes and compression across runs.
